comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record finishes painting a panel without repainting completed areas or spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed latch access and coupled extraction versus roller orientation, surface coverage, and boundary control.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits its cavity intact and alone versus required bare cells covered with limited overlap and no table paint. Candidate force thresholds remain unmeasured.
comparison.reason: Surface coverage control does not test latch release or retained-part extraction.
